newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares recover to end at new record high.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares recover to end at new record high.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Swiss shares recovered after a weaker start to post a fourth-straight record close.
"Sell in May and go away does not seem to apply here," a dealer said, adding Swiss shares moved up after an early correction as U.S. bonds rose on latest U.S. data.
"Wall Street seems to be in for another rise, so the prospects are good" for Switzerland, the dealer said.
* The blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) closed at 5,141.7 points, up 7.4 points, or 0.14 percent, from Wednesday's close.
* The all-share Swiss Performance Index (SPI) was up 6.24 points, or 0.19 percent, to 3,245.92.

* Shares of Swissair lost 40 francs to 1,328 francs, possibly pressured by the announcement that several compeptitors, including Lufthansa are to establish closer ties under the name of Star Alliance. "But I think Swissair will be able to face the challenge," one dealer said, noting a loss or 40 francs was not exceptional for the stock.
* On the Swiss Options and Financial Futures Exchange (Soffex), trade concentrated on SMI futures ahead of Friday's Soffex expiry. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
